svg.title: Serve every application
svg.desc: Serve every application. Link a folder, or park them all: Link a folder, or park a whole directory, and every project in it is served at name.test. The web root is found for you. Trusted HTTPS everywhere: Every application is served over HTTPS from Phun's own local certificate authority, trusted by your browsers. PHP per application: Each application picks its own PHP version, and the rest keep theirs. Switch from the app or with phun use. Start something new: Create a Laravel, WordPress, CodeIgniter, CakePHP, Slim, static or HTML application, or bring an existing project or a Git repository. Domains and proxies: Add subdomains and wildcards, proxy a .test name to a local port, or send one path such as /reverb to another server. Share on a public URL: Share an application through Cloudflare Tunnel, for webhooks, demos and other devices. Works without admin rights: No admin rights to hand? Every application is also reachable at http://localhost/~name.test. An infrastructure canvas: Each application's services drawn as a canvas. Add a database, cache or storage and Phun writes the settings into its .env. Every PHP version you need: Several PHP versions side by side, each with its own php.ini settings and extensions. Native services: MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis and Meilisearch as native services, started with the app. No Docker, no VM. Every email, caught: Every email your applications send is caught and readable in the Mail viewer: rendered, as plain text or as raw source. S3-compatible storage: Object storage on your machine, with public or private buckets and a browser for what is in them. Queues, scheduler and Reverb: Queue workers, as many as you need, the scheduler and Reverb, for each Laravel application. Developer tools on demand: Composer, Node.js, Bun, NVM, the Laravel installer and WP-CLI, installed when you need them, without a system package manager.
